messages:
julie: Quick heads-up — launching a preview of Dedicated pools backed by NVIDIA Blackwell B200 (b200) in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) and us-west-3 (Phoenix) starting tomorrow 08:00 UTC. :tada:

omar: Nice! Who's eligible for the preview? any quota or reservation changes?

julie: Preview is opt-in. Existing Dedicated customers can request B200 capacity through the console or via support ticket; new customers can join the waitlist. No automatic migrations.

capacity-bot: [automated] Pool creation window scheduled: 2026-04-01T08:00:00Z -> 2026-04-03T20:00:00Z. Estimated initial capacity: 50 B200 GPUs per region.

samir: Pricing note for sales folks: B200 will be priced between h200 and h100v2 in our reserved SKU table. Exact numbers in the billing sheet — ping me if you need a quote for an enterprise commit.

lisa: Ops/Runbook highlights: B200 pools have slightly different thermal and instance sizing characteristics — when creating pools set instance_type: nva-b200.large and use the new driver bundle v1.4. See docs link: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/b200-ops (internal).

andre: Is burst capacity supported for these pools? we still need burst for short warm-up jobs.

julie: Yes — burst is enabled but limited for preview (max 20% of committed in-region). We'll expose a toggle in the console for Dedicated admins.

omar: Any changes to routing/fallbacks? e.g., if B200 capacity exhausted, what do we fall back to?

julie: Smart routing will prefer B200 for compatible models. If capacity is constrained, requests will fallback to h200-reserved or h100v2 depending on customer's routing policy. We added automatic downgrade protections to avoid silent performance regressions.

support-bot: [automated] Creating internal incident channel #b200-preview-ops for on-call during rollout window.

lisa: Can we get a short checklist for customers to test model correctness on B200? small perf/compat checklist would be useful.

julie: Yes — short checklist (1) run smoke-generation on standard prompts, (2) validate kv-cache resume on chat replay, (3) check float outputs vs baseline with quantized models. We'll push a repo with example tests by EOD.

samir: Sales ask: will commitments for B200 be supported in Dedicated contracts or only as an add-on?

julie: Committed reservations supported after preview (beta SLA). During preview, we offer temporary reservations with 30-day notice. Roadmap will add long-term reserved SKUs in next quarter.

omar: Ops request: Add health checks for NVSwitch and driver mismatches. We've seen subtle hangs on early B200 kernels elsewhere.

julie: Good call — infra team will add an extra NVSwitch health probe; infra lead @omar will coordinate the rollout.

andre: Any planned limits for per-customer pool size in preview?

julie: Yes — per-customer soft cap 16 B200 GPUs in preview. If you need more, open a support ticket with workload details.

samir: I'll update the partner KB and let enterprise AEs know.

julie: Docs, pricing, and the preview sign-up form: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/b200-preview (internal). For ops questions ping #eng-runtime or @omar. Thanks all — we'll post a short postmortem/summary in this thread after the first 48 hours. :rocket:
